title: Dolphins' initial 53-man roster is youngest in the league

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dolphins' initial 53-man roster is youngest in the league
sources.description: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said last week that the team's success for the 2026 season won't be measured by their place in the standings because "this year’s so much about developing who we are as a football team" as they move into the future.
